recipe:
# lc runs recipes as `bash -c` with no `set -e`, so without this a failed
# compute would exit 0 via the trailing `rm` and lc would commit a
# truncated artifact as successfully produced.
set -e
x=$(mktemp -d) && tar xzf results/submitted/two_point/xi_scan/xi_sweep_bundle.tar.gz -C $x
c=$(mktemp -d) && tar xzf results/submitted/covariance/cov_scan/cov_sweep_bundle.tar.gz -C $c
# NB: braced shell expansions cannot be used in a sweep template — the
# expander claims that syntax. Bare $cb only.
ver=$(python src/papers/bmodes/scripts/paper_config.py --config results/submitted/catalog/selected_config.yaml --scan-version SP_v1.4.11.3)
cb=covariance_"$ver"_A_integration
python src/papers/bmodes/scripts/compute_cosebis_pte_single.py \
  --config results/submitted/catalog/selected_config.yaml \
  --xi-integration "$x/$ver"_xi_minsep=0.5_maxsep=300.0_nbins=1000_npatch=1.txt \
  --cov-integration "$c/$cb/$cb"_processed.txt \
  --version $ver --blind A \
  --out-file results/submitted/cosebis/cosebis_pte_scan/cosebis_ptes_sp_v1p4p11p3.npz
rm -rf "$x" "$c"
